head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Cross-project completeness audit of recent DXF/DWG issue reports against existing local source and test owners; no code, test, fixture, dependency, or external execution.

crosswalk.finding: Reported DWG-to-DXF block traversal skips later named/anonymous/paper-space block bodies and has an ASCII/Binary mirror.
crosswalk.local_owner: tests/block_owner_tests.cpp generated ASCII/Binary body-identity and attributed-INSERT matrix
crosswalk.disposition: Existing local serializer invariant covers the trigger and output closure. Does not test LibreDWG's mechanism or provide customer-DWG reader evidence; no duplicate test.

crosswalk.finding: DXF-to-DWG parser reports zero HATCH ordinate, unusual ATTDEF tag, and embedded-MTEXT field boundaries.
crosswalk.local_owner: Existing HATCH, ATTDEF, and embedded-MTEXT PAR-05/7M generated controls
crosswalk.disposition: Existing controls and Autodesk field contracts remain the local authority; do not copy broad unknown-code skipping.

crosswalk.finding: Peer reader dropped zero-height text-derived records; issue is closed and linked to #1201.
crosswalk.disposition: No local defect found. Conditionally add generated zero-height standalone TEXT and ATTDEF cases to the existing focused test when the shared group-40 route is next changed.

crosswalk.finding: TABLE block-cell DWG/DXF representation discrepancy; separate AC1032 DWG-writer MLEADER-context corruption report.
crosswalk.local_owner: Existing PAR-126 typed incomplete TABLE state; PAR-07/S8 standalone object-context and writer-evidence boundaries
crosswalk.disposition: Keep UNKNOWN/EMPTY/block references distinct; DWG-writer behavior is not a libdxfrw DWG-writer requirement.

crosswalk.finding: Malformed timestamp reaches Windows UCRT strftime with invalid tm_mday and aborts.
crosswalk.local_owner: DWG header time read/write paths and existing dwgHeaderTime split selector
crosswalk.disposition: No analogous local calendar formatter found. Keep a conditional Windows hardening lead; add no test absent a corresponding local call path or reproduced abort.

crosswalk.finding: Peer test-data golden-reference workflow and SHX sidecar provenance/permission are questioned.
crosswalk.local_owner: Existing fixture admission, provenance, and no-new-external-fixture constraints
crosswalk.disposition: Repository presence is not enough to establish correctness, rights, or sidecar completeness; bind provenance and resource identity before composed use.

crosswalk.finding: Proxy-preferred viewer placement issue is a projection problem; ACIS entity parsing/export is explicitly partial.
crosswalk.local_owner: Existing proxy carrier/placement checks and PAR-07/S8 ACIS evidence gate
crosswalk.disposition: Keep viewer behavior separate from codec correctness and ezdxf ACIS use bounded to pinned carrier/projection checks.

plan_delta.conditional_test_refinement: Under existing PAR-05/7AR, add zero-height standalone TEXT and ATTDEF generated positives only when the shared group-40 text-family route is next changed.
